name: Hainan Expressway Co., Ltd.
summary: Hainan Expressway Co., Ltd., established in 1993 and based in Haikou, China, is fundamentally involved in the development, operation, and upkeep of China's extensive expressway systems. Beyond its core highway management, the company also undertakes broader transportation infrastructure initiatives and property development. Furthermore, it allocates capital and resources to the construction of hotel and tourism facilities. Its diversified operations also extend into the financial sector, land parcel development, and advertising services.
